OBJECTIVE_CHAIN: Retain the original three-mechanism question toward brain structure; verify that C14-C16 are valid evidence before using them to choose a new experiment.
BIO_STARTING_MECHANISM: Declared model only: tau_m*x'=-x-g*k*x(t-tau)+g*u, tau=L/v+tau_syn. No assertion that a biological loop has these parameters.
CE_DELTA: None added. Audit the existing generating and measurement assumptions.
MEASUREMENT_MODEL: Existing fwd_loop.py: fixed-amplitude random Fourier phases, exponential rate link, circular calcium convolution, rounded and modulo-indexed sampling, additive imaging noise.
DATA_PROVENANCE: Existing source files and result JSON only; no raw biological data or new download.
DATA_SPLIT: No biological train or holdout opened; deterministic mathematical witnesses and fixed synthetic seed 20260905.
OBSERVABLES: Characteristic-root real part in s^-1 and substitution residual
Actual versus declared sampling interval in seconds and latent wraps
Gain/efficacy normalized autocorrelation before and after exponential observation
Recovered noiseless delay from unwrapped phase slope in seconds
C15 gain application count and placebo centering provenance
ESTIMANDS: Validity of prior computational evidence; not biological treatment effects.
RESIDUAL_RULE: Characteristic equation normalized residual <=1e-9; algebraic scale equality <=1e-10; delay recovery absolute error <=1e-10 s. A positive root with valid residual disproves asymptotic stability. No finite root scan is used to prove stability.
FALSIFIER: One valid positive characteristic root defeats causal stationary-linear interpretation. One affine-invariant statistic changed by the actual nonlinear observation defeats transport of the latent scaling proof to all recorded statistics.
MATCHED_CONTROLS: Preserve latent spectral ratio as positive algebra control; compare identical random phases under matched product g*k; exact flat phase as delay null.
MODEL_SELECTION: No candidate fitting or selection on biology; audit witnesses only.
REVISION_TRIGGER: Any model-validity failure stops use of C14-C16 as confirmation or full-observation impossibility evidence. Preserve originals and register a separate replacement development contract.
